protocol.protocol: SGLang PR35629: GSM8K zero-shot/chat, greedy T0/top_p1/top_k1, 2048 output limit, concurrency1; 128 examples.

benchmark.ttft_measurement: Server Prometheus sum/count difference after warmup; not client streaming TTFT.

answer_extraction_false_negatives.explanation: Answer gives 160 minutes followed by equivalent 2 hours 40 minutes; the public parser takes the last number.
Answer states $75.00 and then repeats the 30-day interval; parser takes 30.
Answer states 5 cars and repeats first 15 minutes; parser takes 15.

manual_review.interpretation: The 7 officially unscored items contain 3 extraction false negatives and 4 truncations; do not label all 7 mathematical errors or silently replace the official score.

preflight.tokenizer_output_handling: input_ids length, not encoding dictionary key count

limitations: First 128 GSM8K test examples, zero-shot, greedy, concurrency1, 2048-token cap; not full 1319-example test set.
Generated-token counts include reasoning and truncated reasoning, not just final visible answer tokens.
Ready NPU process memory snapshot is not inference peak usage.
No matched non-speculative 128-question accuracy comparison; do not attribute failures to speculation or SSM dtype.
Speculation counters can include discarded EOS/tail candidates; tokens-per-round is a counter convention.
Incremental receipt/progress writes are outside per-request timers but inside whole-evaluation elapsed.
